cases.title: Clean-stack readiness and capability discovery

uiActions.documentPhrase: Wait for explicit API, Web, and Worker-heartbeat readiness output.
Refresh the homepage once and confirm that service status does not regress to an error state.

finalBusinessFacts: The real Web page and API are ready.
Reference Data counts and capability text agree.

cases.title: Temporary-account login, session persistence and re-login

uiActions.documentPhrase: Sign in again
Click “Log out.”

readOnlyApiVerification: GET protected Trip detail after browser login
finalBusinessFacts: The browser session survives refresh and a same-origin tab.
Logout removes access and re-login restores the same Trip.

cases.title: Standard five-day multi-destination Trip creation

uiActions.documentPhrase: Click “Create my Trip” on the homepage.
Click “Create Trip” and observe the button change to “Creating…”.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET Trip Destinations through the public Trip response
finalBusinessFacts: Exactly one five-day Trip is created.
Two destinations and five consecutive Days persist after refresh.

cases.title: Single-day minimum-value Trip

uiActions.documentPhrase: Open the new-Trip page.
Refresh and read the Day list.

finalBusinessFacts: Exactly one Day exists and its date equals the Trip date.
The selected USD currency persists.

cases.title: Leap-date, mixed destination delimiters and maximum form values

uiActions.documentPhrase: Enter 99 travelers and select JPY.

dataMatrix.destinations: 上海, 杭州，舟山、南京

finalBusinessFacts: Three Days are generated for the leap-year boundary.
All four destinations and the maximum traveler value persist.

cases.title: Duplicate submit and idempotent Trip creation

uiActions.documentPhrase: Immediately try clicking the button again and pressing Enter.
Replay the same Idempotency-Key in developer tools to simulate a safe retry after the first response was lost.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET Trip list and compare created record count

dataMatrix.network: delayed response followed by connection failure

finalBusinessFacts: One Trip exists after the retry.
No duplicate Trip is created and the browser reaches the original Trip.

cases.title: Trip date extension and empty-Day contraction

uiActions.documentPhrase: Change the end date to 2026-10-05 and preview the change.
Confirm that only empty Days 4/5 are removed, then refresh again.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET Trip Days before and after date change
finalBusinessFacts: Existing Day and Item IDs are retained on extension.
Only empty Days 4 and 5 are removed on contraction.

cases.title: Trip update, soft delete and restore lifecycle

uiActions.documentPhrase: Open Trip settings, enter the update data, and save.
Open Deleted/Trash and restore it.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET restored Trip and retained Item
finalBusinessFacts: Updated Trip fields persist.
Delete is soft, and restore returns the same Trip and related Item.

cases.title: Complete Itinerary Item type and field matrix

uiActions.documentPhrase: Select each of the six Item types and fill every field in the matrix.
Refresh, then open and verify every Item again.

finalBusinessFacts: All six Item types are persisted with their type-specific fields.
Every Item remains readable after refresh.

cases.title: Item edit, autosave and reload

uiActions.documentPhrase: Observe saving/saved status after each input.
Rapidly change the description three times, ending with “Final description.”

finalBusinessFacts: The last edit wins without stale overwrite.
Item fields and expense survive refresh.

cases.title: Copy, edit copied Item and soft delete

uiActions.documentPhrase: Copy it to Day 2.
Return to Day 1, delete the original, and confirm.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET copied Item history where available
finalBusinessFacts: The copy has a new ID and independent edits.
The original is soft-deleted while the copy remains readable and writable.

cases.title: Same-day reorder across mouse, keyboard and touch

uiActions.documentPhrase: On desktop, drag into B→A→D→C order.
Open the same Day at Pixel 7 viewport and move once using touch or an equivalent control.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET ordered Day Items after each reorder
finalBusinessFacts: Mouse, keyboard, and mobile-equivalent input persist one complete Item order each.
No Item is omitted or duplicated.

cases.title: Custom transport mode lifecycle

uiActions.documentPhrase: Open transport-mode management in Trip settings.
Create and save the custom Mode above.
Return to settings, deactivate the Mode, then open both the existing Item and a new-Item form.

finalBusinessFacts: The custom Mode is selectable immediately and persists after refresh.
Timeline, map, details, and route styling expose the same label/icon/color/lineStyle.
After deactivation, the old Item is readable with a disabled warning and a new Item does not offer the Mode by default.

cases.title: Explicit location search, candidate confirmation and persistence

uiActions.documentPhrase: Click explicit search and wait for candidates.
Save the Item, refresh, and reopen it.

finalBusinessFacts: No candidate is silently selected.
The explicitly confirmed Location and Item relationship survive refresh.

cases.title: Map pick, Marker drag and manual coordinate persistence

uiActions.documentPhrase: Drag the Marker to the second coordinate and save.
Open manual coordinate input, enter the final coordinate, and confirm.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET Location after each coordinate adjustment
finalBusinessFacts: Manual coordinates have precedence and persist as WGS84.
The final Location remains stable after refresh.

cases.title: Full runtime route-to-MapLibre happy path

uiActions.documentPhrase: Wait for the page to show route generation, then for generation to complete.
Open the global map and inspect basemap, Markers, routes, and attribution.
sourceMarkers: Map data © On The Road fixture

finalBusinessFacts: The Worker-generated route reaches the public Route API and real MapLibre surface.
Marker, route, provider, quality, and endpoint facts remain after refresh.

cases.title: Cross-day and transport-internal route matrix

uiActions.documentPhrase: Switch between Day and global maps and inspect each Segment.
Confirm the route-gap explanation around F.

readOnlyApiVerification: GET route status after reorder/mode change
finalBusinessFacts: Cross-day and transport-internal segments are scoped correctly.
Unconfirmed Locations produce an explicit gap rather than a fabricated route.

cases.title: Multi-image upload and gallery happy path

uiActions.documentPhrase: Select all three images in one upload action.
Delete the first image and confirm deletion.

finalBusinessFacts: Each real file reaches ready through upload, scan, and Worker processing.
Caption, cover, order, lightbox, delete confirmation, and refresh state are correct.

cases.title: Multi-currency expense and summary reconciliation

uiActions.documentPhrase: Enter each Expense while creating its owning Item in the daily itinerary editor.
Open rate management and enter manual USD, JPY, and VND to CNY rates.

finalBusinessFacts: Original Decimal amounts and rate snapshots reconcile to the daily CNY summary.
Refresh retains rates, original amounts, and the read-only detail tree.

cases.title: Three-format import, mapping and staging preview

uiActions.documentPhrase: Observe upload-session creation, upload, scan, and inspection states.
Change at least one Mapping and save.
Select an error row, choose “Skip error,” and complete secondary confirmation.

finalBusinessFacts: All three files complete upload, scan, inspection, Mapping, and Preview through the UI.
Raw/normalized values, status counts, errors, skip confirmation, and refresh restoration are visible.
Formal Item, Location, and Expense counts are unchanged because the case does not commit production rows.

cases.title: Full currency Reference Data availability and normalization

uiActions.documentPhrase: Select each currency and create a minimum single-day Trip; automation may parameterize 15 runs.
Upload an import containing all 15 codes and the `RMB` alias, then enter Preview.
Confirm `RMB` normalizes to `CNY` and other codes remain unchanged.

finalBusinessFacts: All 15 currencies create Trips and Item-owned Expenses with original uppercase codes.
Trip, Expense, rate, and Import selectors share the same 15-code set.
RMB is normalized to CNY while other codes remain their ISO code.

cases.title: Global/Day map scope and stable MapLibre sizing

uiActions.documentPhrase: Click Day 1 in the left itinerary and confirm that the right map fits and displays only the Day 1 marker and routes.
Observe the coordinate map for at least 750 ms and confirm that its height remains fixed without continuous growth.

finalBusinessFacts: Global and Day scopes show the correct persisted markers and routes.
Both real MapLibre canvases remain bounded at their documented heights after delayed measurement.
